FINANCIAL_OBLIGATION.invariant: Every non-cancelled obligation must be attributable to at least one causal non-financial object.

FINANCIAL_MOVEMENT.invariant: A confirmed movement must either settle at least one obligation or carry a causal non-financial relation explaining why the money moved.

rules: PAYABLE obligation can only be settled by OUT movement.
RECEIVABLE obligation can only be settled by IN movement.
Sum of ACTIVE settlements for a movement cannot exceed movement amount.
Sum of ACTIVE settlements for an obligation cannot exceed obligation amount.
Settlement currency must equal movement and obligation currency.

operational_position.warning: This is an operational position, not a statutory accounting balance and not a bank reconciliation by itself.

reconciliation.complete_when: All CONFIRMED movements in scope are RECONCILED.

causality.movement_orphan_rule: A movement with no settlement must have a non-financial causal relationship.
causality.money_traceability: Every settled amount can navigate movement -> settlement -> obligation -> cause, and back.
